properties.description: Generic parameterised Azure SQL table. One dataset serves every staging table in the warehouse - pass schemaName and tableName at activity level. Resist the urge to create DS_AzureSql_StgYellowTaxiTrip, DS_AzureSql_StgTaxiZone and so on: each concrete dataset is another artifact to deploy, review and keep in sync, and none of them carries information the activity does not already have.
